verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Deel handles global payroll processing and contract/API capabilities, but nothing describes configuring multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams; only high-level marketing claims about 'running payroll across 150+ countries' are present. Missing for 10: any documentation of pay schedule/frequency configuration, per-team schedule assignment, or admin UI/API support for this feature.
